item.title: Morgan Wallen, Garth Brooks, Taylor Swift & More Artists With Most Weeks at No. 1 on Top Country Albums Chart: Full List
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome to this week's country music update. We've got a milestone to celebrate, courtesy of Morgan Wallen. His album "I'm the Problem" has just notched its 45th nonconsecutive week at the top of Billboard's Top Country Albums chart. That's dated July 25, for those keeping track.
[Short music transition]
Host: This achievement is all the more impressive because Wallen has now spent a total of 231 weeks at number one on this chart, solidifying his lead as the artist with the most weeks at the top spot in the chart's 62-year history. And get this - he first reached number one just three years ago, on August 15, 2020.
[Short music transition]
Host: Wallen's "I'm the Problem" spent the last 13 weeks at number two, behind Ella Langley's "Dandelion". But now it's back on top, and that's a testament to Wallen's enduring popularity. By the way, did you know that Top Country Albums has been around since 1964, when it was first called Hot Country Albums? Johnny Cash's "Ring of Fire" compilation headed the inaugural chart.
[Short music transition]
Host: Today, 21 artists have logged 50 or more weeks at number one on this chart, with male solo artists dominating the list. But we're also seeing more diversity, with female solo artists and groups making their mark. And who knows, maybe we'll see more artists from underrepresented backgrounds joining this list in the future.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's all for this week. Congratulations to Morgan Wallen on his chart-topping achievement. We'll be back with more music news and updates soon. Thanks for tuning in!
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
